replies.body: Hopefully this changes a few thing within the staff team. I know Midnight will do good with this chance, he was part of the Resistance so he should know about all the parts of the staff team that need fixing. As for Zeus choice is questionable not going to lie, I personally have a very shity past with Zeus because of his outstanding rudeness to players. I just hope he makes the changes that will actually save this server and make it a better place once again. Congrats.
